assets.prompt: Production-ready original 2D wuxia combat VFX sprite atlas for “Chú Âm Phá Vọng” (curse-school basic single-target projectile), on a transparent RGBA background. Exactly a 4-column by 4-row sheet of 16 separate sequential animation frames, equal square cells, consistent scale and pivot, no borders or labels, no text, no watermark. Unique silhouette: a slim hand-painted ink-wisp talisman folded into a small crescent-shaped echo dart, warm ivory paper flecks, deep plum-black brush edges, one restrained jade-white luminous core, tiny antique-gold seal strokes. The animation reads left-to-right and tells: sealed paper mote gathers beside a caster; a narrow ink stroke forms; the crescent echo dart releases with two uneven translucent brush tails; it travels as a focused projectile; at the destination it makes one compact silent ink-splash / paper flick impact; then separated wisps and paper dust fade naturally. Keep all 16 poses clearly different, cleanly centered within each cell with transparent margins. Classic JX / Võ Lâm / Kiếm Thế painterly sprite art, semi-transparent light, refined brush texture, crisp and legible at small game scale. Do not include character, background, floor, circle, neon geometry, skulls, gore, generic energy orb, or oversized glow.
